# mTrio and mAnalog: MicroDexed-touch's Trio and Analog synths as LV2 instruments
#
#   cmake -B build -G Ninja && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build
#   cmake --install build --prefix /usr     # -> /usr/lib/lv2/mtrio.lv2, manalog.lv2
#
# The TTL (mtrio.lv2/*.ttl, manalog.lv2/*.ttl) and src/ports_*.h are
# generated by tools/gen_ttl.cpp and committed: cross builds don't run the
# generator. After changing the generator or the tables:
#   cmake --build build --target regenerate
# No architecture specific flags here: they come from the build (CFLAGS,
# CXXFLAGS).

cmake_minimum_required (VERSION 3.16)
project (mdt-va VERSION 0.0.1 LANGUAGES C CXX)

option (VA_TESTS "build the tests (ctest)" ON)

set (CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set (CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set (CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set (CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set (CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if (NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
	set (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif ()

find_path (LV2_INCLUDE_DIR lv2/core/lv2.h)
if (NOT LV2_INCLUDE_DIR)
	message (FATAL_ERROR "LV2 headers (lv2/core/lv2.h) not found: install the LV2 development package")
endif ()
find_library (MATH_LIBRARY m)

# common/ (shared with the other plugins of mdt-lv2): the generator's TTL
# helpers, the render test host
set (COMMON ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../common)
set (ENGINE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/engine)
set (ENGINE_COMMON ${ENGINE}/dsp_basics.cpp)
set (ENGINE_TRIO ${ENGINE}/trio_engine.cpp)
set (ENGINE_ANALOG ${ENGINE}/analog_engine.cpp)
set (WARNINGS -Wall -Wextra)

# the plugins: C style C++ (the engine is C++), no exceptions, no RTTI;
# --as-needed drops libstdc++ (nothing uses it)
include (CheckLinkerFlag OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE HAVE_CHECK_LINKER_FLAG)
set (VA_VERSION_SCRIPT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/va.map)
if (HAVE_CHECK_LINKER_FLAG)
	check_linker_flag (CXX "-Wl,--version-script=${VA_VERSION_SCRIPT}" HAVE_VERSION_SCRIPT)
	check_linker_flag (CXX "-Wl,--no-undefined" HAVE_NO_UNDEFINED)
	check_linker_flag (CXX "-Wl,--as-needed" HAVE_AS_NEEDED)
endif ()

set (BUNDLES)
foreach (synth mtrio manalog)
	if (synth STREQUAL "manalog")
		set (analog 1)
		set (engine_src ${ENGINE_ANALOG})
	else ()
		set (analog 0)
		set (engine_src ${ENGINE_TRIO})
	endif ()
	set (bundle_dir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${synth}.lv2)
	add_library (${synth} MODULE src/va.cpp ${engine_src} ${ENGINE_COMMON})
	target_include_directories (${synth} PRIVATE src ${ENGINE} ${LV2_INCLUDE_DIR})
	target_compile_definitions (${synth} PRIVATE VA_ANALOG=${analog} VA_PORTS="ports_${synth}.h")
	target_compile_options (${synth} PRIVATE -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti)
	set_source_files_properties (src/va.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "${WARNINGS}")
	set_target_properties (${synth} PROPERTIES
		PREFIX ""
		OUTPUT_NAME ${synth}
		SUFFIX ".so"
		C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
		CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
		LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${bundle_dir})
	if (HAVE_VERSION_SCRIPT)
		target_link_options (${synth} PRIVATE "-Wl,--version-script=${VA_VERSION_SCRIPT}")
		set_property (TARGET ${synth} APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS ${VA_VERSION_SCRIPT})
	endif ()
	if (HAVE_NO_UNDEFINED)
		target_link_options (${synth} PRIVATE "-Wl,--no-undefined")
	endif ()
	if (HAVE_AS_NEEDED)
		target_link_options (${synth} PRIVATE "-Wl,--as-needed")
	endif ()
	if (MATH_LIBRARY)
		target_link_libraries (${synth} PRIVATE ${MATH_LIBRARY})
	endif ()

	# the bundle in the build tree (for the tests and LV2_PATH=build)
	foreach (ttl manifest.ttl ${synth}.ttl presets.ttl)
		configure_file (${synth}.lv2/${ttl} ${bundle_dir}/${ttl} COPYONLY)
	endforeach ()

	install (TARGETS ${synth} LIBRARY DESTINATION lib/lv2/${synth}.lv2)
	install (FILES ${synth}.lv2/manifest.ttl ${synth}.lv2/${synth}.ttl ${synth}.lv2/presets.ttl
		DESTINATION lib/lv2/${synth}.lv2)
endforeach ()
set_source_files_properties (${ENGINE_COMMON} ${ENGINE_TRIO} ${ENGINE_ANALOG} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "${WARNINGS}")

# ---- the TTL generator (desktop only) ----

if (NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
	add_executable (gen_ttl tools/gen_ttl.cpp ${ENGINE_TRIO} ${ENGINE_ANALOG} ${ENGINE_COMMON})
	target_include_directories (gen_ttl PRIVATE ${COMMON} src tools ${ENGINE})
	target_compile_options (gen_ttl PRIVATE ${WARNINGS})
	if (MATH_LIBRARY)
		target_link_libraries (gen_ttl PRIVATE ${MATH_LIBRARY})
	endif ()
	add_custom_target (regenerate
		COMMAND gen_ttl trio ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mtrio.lv2 ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ports_mtrio.h
		COMMAND gen_ttl analog ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/manalog.lv2 ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ports_manalog.h
		DEPENDS gen_ttl
		COMMENT "regenerating mtrio.lv2/*.ttl, manalog.lv2/*.ttl and src/ports_*.h in the source tree"
		VERBATIM)
endif ()

# ---- tests ----

if (VA_TESTS AND NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
	enable_testing ()
	set (TESTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests)

	# the TTL and ports headers as committed == regenerated
	add_test (NAME ttl_regenerate COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
		-DGEN=$<TARGET_FILE:gen_ttl> -DSRC=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} -DOUT=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/regen
		-P ${TESTS}/check_ttl.cmake)

	# validation of the bundles (skipped without the tools);
	# common/zynthian-schema.ttl declares Zynthian's lv2:displayPriority
	find_program (SORD_VALIDATE sord_validate)
	find_program (LV2_VALIDATE lv2_validate)
	find_program (LV2LINT lv2lint)
	find_program (NM_PROGRAM NAMES ${CMAKE_NM} nm)
	set (LV2_SPEC_DIR /usr/lib/lv2 CACHE PATH "the installed LV2 specifications (core.lv2, ...)")
	foreach (synth trio analog)
		set (name m${synth})
		set (bundle_dir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${name}.lv2)
		set (uri "https://github.com/hjanetzek/mdt-lv2/${name}")

		add_test (NAME symbols_frozen_${name} COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
			-DGEN=$<TARGET_FILE:gen_ttl> -DSYNTH=${synth} -DFROZEN=${TESTS}/symbols_${name}.txt
			-DOUT=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/symbols_${name}.txt -P ${TESTS}/check_symbols.cmake)

		if (SORD_VALIDATE AND EXISTS ${LV2_SPEC_DIR}/core.lv2)
			add_test (NAME sord_validate_${name} COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
				-DSORD=${SORD_VALIDATE} -DSPECS=${LV2_SPEC_DIR} -DSCHEMA=${COMMON}/zynthian-schema.ttl
				-DBUNDLE=${bundle_dir} -DNAME=${name} -P ${TESTS}/check_sord.cmake)
		endif ()
		if (LV2_VALIDATE)
			add_test (NAME lv2_validate_${name} COMMAND ${LV2_VALIDATE} ${COMMON}/zynthian-schema.ttl
				${bundle_dir}/manifest.ttl ${bundle_dir}/${name}.ttl ${bundle_dir}/presets.ttl)
			set_tests_properties (lv2_validate_${name} PROPERTIES FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "error:")
		endif ()
		if (LV2LINT)
			# warnings are errors (notes are not); online tests off
			add_test (NAME lv2lint_${name} COMMAND ${LV2LINT} -Mpack -Ewarn -I ${bundle_dir}/ ${uri})
			set_tests_properties (lv2lint_${name} PROPERTIES FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "\\[FAIL\\]|\\[WARN\\]")
		endif ()

		if (NM_PROGRAM)
			add_test (NAME imports_${name} COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
				-DNM=${NM_PROGRAM} -DPLUGIN=$<TARGET_FILE:${name}> -P ${TESTS}/check_imports.cmake)
		endif ()

		# the render test host: the plugin (dlopen) against MDT's
		# wrapper, allocation and mixer driving the copied engine
		if (synth STREQUAL "analog")
			set (analog 1)
			set (engine_src ${ENGINE_ANALOG})
		else ()
			set (analog 0)
			set (engine_src ${ENGINE_TRIO})
		endif ()
		add_executable (render_test_${name} tests/render_test.cpp ${COMMON}/testhost/testhost.c
			${ENGINE_TRIO} ${ENGINE_ANALOG} ${ENGINE_COMMON})
		target_include_directories (render_test_${name} PRIVATE src tools ${ENGINE} ${COMMON}/testhost ${LV2_INCLUDE_DIR})
		target_compile_definitions (render_test_${name} PRIVATE VA_ANALOG=${analog} VA_PORTS="ports_${name}.h")
		target_compile_options (render_test_${name} PRIVATE ${WARNINGS})
		target_link_libraries (render_test_${name} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
		if (MATH_LIBRARY)
			target_link_libraries (render_test_${name} PRIVATE ${MATH_LIBRARY})
		endif ()
		add_dependencies (render_test_${name} ${name})
		add_test (NAME render_${name} COMMAND render_test_${name} $<TARGET_FILE:${name}>)
	endforeach ()
endif ()
